target_definition.best_q_tie_break: lowest q among equal AP values

descriptor_semantics.gate_ln_slice_rms: per-scale slice RMS after the gate's actual joint LayerNorm(concat(GAP(A3),GAP(A4),GAP(A5)))
descriptor_semantics.spatial_cos_mean: mean per-location channel cosine cos(R[:, :, h, w], P(A)[:, :, h, w])

caveats: exploratory evidence only: same val6 and non-independent conditions. A scalar norm or slice RMS cannot establish whether the full LayerNorm vector direction contains predictive information. Hard best-q correlations are secondary because the five-point sweep is discrete and frequently weakly identifiable.
